In the process he felt the riches of God’s glory displayed in him, because he could turn his own experience into help and encouragement for others.
This story shows us that even in hardship and challenge, God is preparing us to be vessels of His glory. Our life experiences are not just personal stories but a testimony to God’s glory.

Dear family, let us always remember in life that we are vessels specially prepared by God and that His glory is to be displayed in us. Whatever challenges we face, let us firmly believe in God’s mercy and plan, and be witnesses of His glory.
ah: Romans 9:23 emphasizes that God makes known the riches of His glory on vessels of mercy that He prepared beforehand. This gives us concrete ways to live out God’s glory:
a: Examine yourself to be a fitting vessel
Reflect on your life and conduct, making sure they are clean and spotless and able to carry God’s glory. Daily prayer and Bible study are the foundation for reaching this goal.
Take an active part in church life
Through the church’s various activities and services, make yourself a tool God uses to show His glory. Whether in music, service, or teaching others, each is an opportunity to show God’s glory.
Show mercy to others
Show mercy and grace to others, just as God has done for us. This is not limited to material help but includes time, attention, and emotional support.
Share your testimony
Share with others what God has done in your life, especially how He has shown His glory and power in adversity. This can inspire others to seek and experience God’s glory too.
Ask for God’s mercy and guidance
Pray often that God will make us the prepared vessels, able to carry and display His glory.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for displaying the riches of Your glory on us, vessels of mercy. Help us to cleanse ourselves each day so that our lives and service are a witness to Your glory. May we experience Your guidance and blessing as we show mercy to others, take part in the church, and share our testimonies. May our every word and deed show Your glory. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sense God’s glory and mercy in every day of your life, and become a vessel of His glory. Amen!

v: Who caused his glorious arm to be at Moses’ right hand? Who divided the waters before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
b: This verse shows us how God’s power and glory were displayed in the history of Israel. When Moses led the Israelites out of Egypt, God divided the Red Sea by His mighty power so that they could cross safely. This miracle showed not only God’s protection and love for His people, but also established His everlasting name in history.

It is like the difficulties and challenges in our lives, when sometimes we feel that everything ahead is dark and we cannot see a way out. But just as God divided the waters before the Red Sea, He will also open a new road in our lives. When we trust Him, His glorious arm will surely move and lead us through our troubles.

A single mother, because of financial pressure, had to work two jobs and care for her young children. She often felt exhausted and almost unable to meet the challenges of life. Yet she firmly believed in God’s help and prayed every day for His guidance. Later she got a better job, with not only higher pay but also more flexible hours, which gave her more time with her children. All this made her deeply feel the movement of God’s glorious arm in her life.
This story tells us that whatever difficulty we face, as long as we trust God, His glorious arm will open a way for us and lead us toward light and hope.

Dear family, let us always remember in life that God’s arm is glorious and able to divide the waters of difficulty for us. Whatever challenges we face, let us firmly believe in God’s power and love, and let Him establish His everlasting name in our lives.
ah: Isaiah 63:12 reminds us that God, through wonderful acts such as moving at the right hand of Moses and dividing the waters, displayed His glorious arm and made for Himself an everlasting name. Here is how we can practice this glory in daily life:
a: Know God’s power and glory
Spend time each day reading God’s Word, especially passages in the Bible that describe God’s miracles, such as Exodus and Joshua. This reminds us of God’s great power and all He has done for us.
Seek God’s guidance in prayer
When you face difficulty or must make a decision, ask God to show His glorious arm of rescue and guidance, as He did for Israel at the Red Sea.
Witness to God’s works
Share with others how God has acted in your life, just as He worked miracles for His people in the past. This can be done through testimony, church sharing, or social media.
Live out faith in action
Look for opportunities to do good in your community and workplace, showing that God’s glorious arm is not only a thing of the past but a present reality.
Encourage others
In fellowship or in the family, encourage others to seek and know this great God, and to let God’s glorious arm be their strength and guide in their lives.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for displaying Your power and glory in our lives through Your glorious arm. Guide us in every challenge and opportunity, and make our lives a platform that witnesses to Your wonderful works. Give us courage and wisdom to exalt Your name in every environment we are in. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God’s glorious arm in every day of your life, walk through hardship, and witness His wonderful works. Amen!

v: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
b: This verse reminds us that God wants us to live lives of dignity and majesty. This dignity and majesty come not from outward clothing or wealth but from purity of heart and reverence for God.

It is like a prince or princess whose nobility comes not only from splendid clothes but from their words and conduct and the nobility within. Each of us is a child of God and has been given a noble identity. So we should adorn ourselves with God’s glory and live a life worthy of our identity.

A young man grew up in poverty, but he always believed he was a child of God and had a noble identity. He studied hard, took an active part in the church’s ministry, and served the people around him with love and good deeds. Although his material conditions were not rich, the light within him and his reverence for God made him stand out among people. His life became a blessing to those around him, and many came close to God because of his testimony.

This story tells us that whatever our outward circumstances, we can adorn ourselves with God’s glory and majesty. When our hearts are full of reverence and love for God, our lives naturally give off a noble air that influences and blesses those around us.

Dear family, let us adorn ourselves with God’s glory and majesty every day, live a noble life, and be witnesses for God. Whatever challenges we face, let us remember our identity and glorify God with this nobility.
ah: Job 40:10 calls on us to adorn ourselves with glory and majesty, and to array ourselves with honor and dignity. This is not outward dress alone but the expression of an inner attitude and conduct. Here is how we can put these principles into practice:
a: Cultivate humility and respect
In your interactions with others, whether family, friends, or coworkers, show an attitude of respect and humility. Remember that true honor comes from our respect and love for others.
Conduct that shows dignity
In daily life, whatever challenges you face, stay calm and dignified. This not only improves your self-image but can also be an example to others.
Careful preparation and performance
In your work and church service, prepare your work and speeches with care, and face every task with a professional and rigorous attitude.
Keep your integrity
Stay clean morally and spiritually, avoid everything that might pollute body and mind, and strive to be a spotless believer.
Reflect God’s glory
Through our way of life and decisions, let our lives reflect God’s glory. Let our words and deeds be consistent, a witness to God’s glory.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, help us to make glory and dignity the adornment of our lives. Give us strength to show Your honor and majesty in our conduct, and to show humility and respect in our dealings with others. May our lives be a reflection of Your glory and glorify Your name through our words and deeds. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you adorn yourself with God’s glory and majesty every day, and live a noble and beautiful life. Amen!
